prevention.title: Solid-material data stops short of lunar oxygen

findings.text: BASS-II tested PMMA, cotton-fiberglass, Nomex and wax samples in 129 tests with measured oxygen from 13.6% to 22.2%. That 22.2% is the highest oxygen any solid-material test in PSI reached.
SAFFIRE-II shows gravity changes which material is worse. Thin silicone sheets burned completely at 1 g but barely in microgravity, while cotton-fiberglass fabric burned its full 29 cm in both.
ACME CFI-G holds all 20 tests at lunar-base conditions, and every one is a gas flame. Its measured oxygen runs from 18% to 40%.

prevention.implication: A lunar base at 30% oxygen or more sits above every solid-material test in PSI. Material choices for it rest on burns at 22.2% oxygen or less.
prevention.gap: No flammability test on a solid above 22.2% oxygen is in PSI yet, and no combustion test in partial gravity.

detection.title: Smoke was measured only in Earth-like cabin air

findings.text: SAME-R measured smoke from Kapton, silicone, lampwick, Pyrell and Teflon in 109 tests, all in cabin air at an assumed 21% oxygen.
SAME ran 20 smoke tests on Teflon, Kapton, silicone rubber, lampwick and dibutyl phthalate, also in cabin air at an assumed 21% oxygen.
DAFT / DAFT-2 flew a particle counter on Arizona road dust to check its readings in microgravity. PSI holds no individual test rows for it.

detection.implication: Every smoke measurement in PSI comes from cabin air at an assumed 21% oxygen. A lunar base at 30% oxygen or more has no smoke data of its own.
detection.gap: No smoke or aerosol test above an assumed 21% oxygen is in PSI yet.

suppression.title: Droplet flames went out up to 30% oxygen

findings.text: FLEX recorded extinction in 88 of 123 droplet tests diluted with carbon dioxide, at 14% to 24% oxygen, and in 40 of 50 diluted with helium, at 13% to 24% oxygen.
In nitrogen alone, FLEX recorded extinction in 58 of 101 droplet tests, from 12% to 30% oxygen. Only 2 of those were at 30% oxygen or more.
BASS-II burned solid samples in 129 tests at 13.6% to 22.2% measured oxygen, and BASS in 121 tests in cabin air at an assumed 21% oxygen. Their tables do not record how each flame ended.

suppression.implication: FLEX recorded only 2 extinctions at 30% oxygen or more, the level expected in a lunar base. How to put out a burning solid at that oxygen is untested in PSI.
suppression.gap: No suppression test on a solid above 22.2% oxygen is in PSI yet. FLEX-2 lists 160 planned droplet conditions without test results in its table.
